solutions.1: Schedule preventive maintenance within 7 days (oiling/greasing, alignment, cleaning).
solutions.2: Emergency overhaul: stop unit, replace bearings / deep-clean + PID test.
solutions.3: Rebalance battery: revise charge setpoint, cell balancing + thermal check.
solutions.4: Replace battery strings; top up emergency reserve to 15%.
solutions.5: Raise transmission to HV 132-220kV, inspect joints, patrol feeder.
solutions.6: Theft protocol: SCADA-vs-meter audit, night patrol, file complaint with distributor.
solutions.7: Weather protection: feather turbines / tilt-drain panels / controlled dam release.
solutions.8: Demand uploader explanation; freeze settlement until data reconciled.
solutions.9: Trim generation setpoint 5%; shift surplus to emergency reserve.
